resolution.quote: Ah, i overlooked https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/commit/42d26080d197f173947e8636abc6bbd295acb07a - so, i'll release 2.14.0 today.

notes: Eligibility agreed at step 6 (library API; UPGRADE). I verified the dialect move at the provider's release tags: message id="33" GLOBAL_POSITION_INT is defined in message_definitions/v1.0/common.xml at release/humble/mavlink/2025.9.9-1 (line 5427), is absent from common.xml at 2025.12.12-1, and appears in standard.xml at 2025.12.12-1 (line 115). The C++ symbol mavlink::common::msg::GLOBAL_POSITION_INT the consumer references was therefore removed by the provider — element_removed_or_renamed is right. Loudness loud_documented/build agreed (colcon compiler error). Resolution recommended agreed: the maintainer committed 42d26080 switching the handler to mavlink::standard::msg::GLOBAL_POSITION_INT and released 2.14.0, but the thread's only shown-working composition is the provider downgrade ('Yes, it works with 2025.9.9.'), i.e. a different composition; the resolved one is not shown building. Note: vooon's intermediate claim that '2025.12.12 has the same standard.xml as 2025.9.9' is contradicted by the release-tag files, and the spec correctly followed the primary files.
